name: Fehlberg 4(5)
description: Runge-Kutta-Fehlberg 5(4) pair. Six stages, 5th order propagation with an embedded 4th order solution for local error estimation (local extrapolation, matching the ``RKCK54`` / ``RKDP54`` convention).
